caption: 🥑🍳 Easy Avocado Egg Breakfast Bites for Toddlers! Need a quick, nutritious breakfast for your little one? These avocado egg bites are soft, delicious, and so easy to make! Plus, they’re a great way to use up leftover bread! 💚 Ingredients: 🥑 1/2 Avocado 🥚 1 egg 🍞 Slice of whole wheat bread, cubed 🧀 2 tbsp shredded cheese 🧄 Garlic powder @Trader Joe's  🫒 Olive oil @traderjoes  Instructions: 1. Mash the avocado in a bowl. 2. Add the egg and mix until combined. 3. Sprinkle in some garlic powder. 4. Add 2 tbsp shredded cheese and cubed whole wheat bread. Mix everything together. 5. Heat olive oil in a skillet over low-medium heat. 6. Scoop small portions into the pan and cook until golden on both sides and the egg is fully cooked. Serve with fresh fruit for an easy toddler breakfast! 🍓 💗 Save this recipe for your next busy morning and follow @busymamaeasybites for more easy toddler recipes!  #easyrecipe #toddlermeals #toddlersnacks #toddlerbreakfast
